events.verdict: Alvarado (NOP) extends a hand into Mann (CHA), affecting his SQBR. The illegal contact occurs prior to any contact initiated by Mann.
Bridges (CHA) and Queen (NOP) come together at the same spot and the contact is marginal.
James (CHA) and Queen (NOP) reach for the rebound and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Mann (CHA) extends his arm into Alvarado (NOP) to create space during the drive.
Murphy III (NOP) is already in Mann's (CHA) path and is firming up when contact occurs.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Queen (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Alvarado (NOP) and Sexton (CHA) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Bey (NOP) maintains a hand on Knueppel's (CHA) back as both players remain stationary. He immediately removes his hand as Knueppel moves off of the ball and does not affect his FOM.
Queen (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Kalkbrenner (CHA).
James (CHA) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
Kalkbrenner (CHA) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP).
Alvarado (NOP) dislodges Sexton (CHA) from his rebounding position.
James (CHA) commits a take foul on Bey (NOP).
Alvarado (NOP) legally contests Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
